objective: Replace the Hugging Face LLM stub with a governed OpenAI-compatible Inference Providers adapter behind the existing AIProviderRegistry, IntelligentRouter and Treasury boundary.

rulesConsidered: IntelligentRouter remains the capability routing authority.
Treasury remains the economic admission authority.
MCP/access surfaces do not become authorities.
No external LLM provider gains F06, CAS or F07 authority.
Provider usage must expose exact token data when available for Treasury settlement.

notes: HF credentials are read from HF_API_KEY/HF_TOKEN/HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY and are not written to repository artifacts.
The adapter uses the fixed Hugging Face router endpoint by default; custom base URL remains configuration-controlled.
Provider error text is bounded before being surfaced.

changes: Replaced the Hugging Face stub implementation with a real chat-completions provider plugin.
Registered Hugging Face in the existing AIProviderRegistry.
Preserved provider selection policies in model IDs such as :fastest/:cheapest/:preferred and explicit provider suffixes.
Added token usage extraction for Treasury execution settlement.
Added dynamic /v1/models discovery and VLM capability detection.
Added config/model/capability entries with the provider disabled by default until intentionally configured.
Reconciled external API registry and .okf state.
verificationPlan: Require CI and Team Change Gate to pass before merge.
Run a live HF Inference Providers smoke only with an explicitly configured token and a deliberately selected model.
Record provider/model/usage evidence separately from repository CI.
notes: IMPLEMENTED means repository adapter + deterministic contract coverage; it is not a live qualification claim.
Hugging Face's current OpenAI-compatible endpoint is chat-completion-only; non-chat tasks remain outside this adapter.
The provider is disabled in static routing config by default so installing the adapter does not silently change model economics.
